definitions.explanation: The area or structure into which a ball must be sent to score, or the act of scoring.
The end point of a race or journey.
An aim or desired result that one works toward.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}{終了|しゅうりょう}{間際|まぎわ}にゴールを{決|き}めた。
examples.english: I scored a goal right before the end of the match.

examples.japanese: マラソンのゴールに{到着|とうちゃく}した。
examples.english: I reached the marathon finish line.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}のゴールは{日本語能力試験|にほんごのうりょくしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}することだ。
examples.english: My goal for this year is to pass the JLPT.

notes:
USAGE: ゴール is used for sports goals, finish lines, and objectives.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ゴールを{決|き}める (to score a goal)
・ゴールに{入|はい}る (to go into the goal)
・ゴールを{目指|めざ}す (to aim for a goal)
・ゴールイン (reaching the goal/finish line; also: getting married)

RELATED WORDS:
・{目標|もくひょう} (objective, target)
・{得点|とくてん} (score, points)
・スタート (start)
